name: Jeremy R. Shuppert
role: Program Leader, TNO Transformation Team, Eastman
bio: Jeremy R. Shuppert is the Program Leader for the Tennessee Operations Transformation Team for Eastman Chemical Company. In his current role, Jeremy is focused on leveraging Eastman’s long-standing cultural strengths to address the ever-increasing demand to continuously improve work execution management systems. Jeremy joined Eastman in 1996 and has served in numerous individual and leadership roles in Maintenance, Operations, and Engineering. Jeremy holds a B.S. degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Tennessee.
